dataset.name: Reported-name/employer Wikipedia discovery
dataset.description: Exploratory source-derived search windows and linked structured statements, not person resolution or affiliation publication.

endpoints.name: wikipedia_search
endpoints.response_root: query.pages; generator=search, namespace 0, five hits, pageprops and revision identifiers/timestamps

endpoints.name: wikidata_entities
endpoints.response_root: entities; wbgetentities over exactly the observed page QIDs, English labels/descriptions/aliases, all claims and enwiki sitelinks

acquisition.pagination: One five-hit Wikipedia window per generated search. The versioned Go planner derives separate person-name, person-name-plus-employer and employer searches. Retain continuation without following it; no inverse-property crawl or endpoint expansion.

partitions.name: capture
partitions.source: Exact source-qualified appearance plan, query-policy and build identities
partitions.purpose: Retain independent observation evidence without changing FEC releases or graph generations.

acquisition.retry_policy: No automatic retries. At most twenty queries and forty serial requests, at least one second apart, 30 seconds/request and five minutes/run. Four MiB/body, 64 MiB/run, 128 KiB/response headers. Fixed HTTPS origins, no redirects, no proxy inheritance, no credentials. Send descriptive user-agent and maxlag=5. Save bounded failed bodies and attempt metadata; stop network calls after the first HTTP, transport or schema failure. Restart explicitly into a new directory.

physical_schema.encoding: Strict UTF-8 JSON; reject duplicate keys, unpaired surrogates, excessive depth and trailing JSON.
physical_schema.null_policy: Do not treat API failures as no matches. Missing items use the source missing flag. Incomplete page metadata blocks use. Raw null/empty forms remain in captured bytes.
physical_schema.schema_fingerprint: Compiled closed envelopes and selected term/identity shapes in internal/source/wikimedia. Claims, sitelinks, limits and continuation retain opaque JSON under the explicit structural contract. Record each observed JSON path/type fingerprint in offline replay; never adopt remote schema changes automatically.

identity.publisher_record_key: Wikipedia pageid plus revision metadata; Wikidata QID plus lastrevid. Neither is a FEC identity.
identity.occurrence_locator: Capture digest, query ordinal, exact request URL and response body digest; page ID or QID within that response.
identity.record_version: Exact response SHA-256 and publisher revision metadata. Cross-endpoint observations are not an atomic snapshot.
identity.duplicate_policy: Retain each distinct source-body/locator appearance. Reject duplicate source references. Share identical kind/text queries while preserving all appearance indexes; never merge donor identities. Preserve all returned pages and candidate QIDs, including alternatives, disambiguation pages and missing items.

time_fields.meaning: Client request time, not validity of an employment or ownership relationship.
Preserve publisher revision and qualified statement time separately from FEC source cycles.

rules: Inputs contain only original name/employer strings and source-body digests/locators. Generic planning checks shape, not source authenticity. The diagnostic corpus adapter verifies pinned as-filed records; it does not use reviewed role labels to choose queries.

Keep raw null, blank and nonblank fields. Default reported-name-employer-searches.v1 renders search terms by replacing punctuation with spaces, retaining letter/number boundaries, token order, case and accents, and individually quoting tokens. This is query formatting, not person-name matching or a literal whole-name identity test.

Opt-in reported-name-employer-searches.v2 preserves every v1 query and adds explained employer-only digit/letter boundaries and one trailing legal-designator omission, using the existing bounded organization vocabulary. Preserve per-appearance derivations on shared queries; never change source strings, expand person names or silently raise the twenty-search budget. Replay recomputes the versioned plan.

Do not infer name order, initials, nicknames, spelling corrections, executive status from occupation, or donor importance from money. Missing name/employer remains explicit; no searchable terms means no request for that input.
At most twenty appearances and twenty generated searches. Sort by exact source reference and query kind/text. Shared requests retain every contributing appearance, not a presumed unique donor.

Follow only Wikipedia-returned page QIDs. Retain all page ranks/revisions and missing/disambiguation states; search rank is not identity confidence. A direct nondeprecated human-type assertion is observed evidence, not a resolved FEC identity.

Extract reported roles using wikimedia/role-statements@1.0.0 within each verified response. Preserve property direction, qualifiers, references and missing endpoint types. Do not merge item versions or fetch arbitrary statement endpoints.

No recursive person/inverse discovery, prose extraction, historical-role screening bridge, identity approval, affiliation graph write or terminal-dollar allocation. Capture usability never means exhaustive discovery.

Background capture always uses maxlag=5 and stops on source failure. No interactive override or automatic fallback is implemented. The earlier explicitly approved interactive review remains a separate observation.

revisions.publisher_model: Mutable community-curated data and search indexes. Search and entity requests occur at different times.
revisions.effective_projection: Offline replay only. No identity winner, cross-response item merge or recurring refresh.

checks.rule: Pin manifest and query digests; verify confined regular body files, size/hash, exact reconstructed requests and request/byte budgets.
Retain invalid bodies, but do not use API errors, warnings, schema drift, incomplete entities or failed/truncated requests as negative search evidence.
Retain candidate multiplicity, missing page/item/type evidence and unattempted searches; every identity, exhaustive-discovery, graph and financial approval remains false.

use.retention: Retain raw capture and exact source/build identities for offline replay. API failures are evidence of a failed observation, not entity absence.
use.disclaimer: Community-curated candidate evidence, not authoritative corporate identity or verified financial connection. Respect upstream licensing and attribution when displaying source content.
